description: Metadata envelope describing how prompt-continuity context is bounded locally across sessions. It records digests and policy references only; it never embeds prompt text, outputs, or personal data.
invariants: An envelope references at most one prior envelope by digest.
Envelope content class may never be upgraded to a sensitive class by this mechanism.
Revocation of a prior consent epoch invalidates forward use of envelopes bound to that epoch.
limitations: The envelope bounds continuity metadata; it does not prove continuity of experience, memory, or identity.
Local envelopes do not prevent disclosure by parties already holding exported copies.
